_about: Facts for scoring. status: verified = checked against the PDF by a person; to_reverify = stated by the advisor from the PDF, to be checked again on the kit images before the run; disputed = cannot be settled reliably yet, goes to the owner for a decision. Counts are never taken from a model or from two models agreeing. A count is settled only on a marked-up sheet, one member one mark.

facts.note: Absent from the app's v3 reading; must be a row even with no instance found.

FB4, FB8, FB10, FB11, HDR1–HDR3: sections to be copied from the schedule onto this list before the run. The app's v3 read FB4 6x12, FB8 PSL 7x11-1/4, FB10 6x10, FB11 4x10, HDR1 4x12, HDR2 4x14, HDR3 PSL 3.5x16 — read without high-resolution tiles, so re-check each.

Areas to count are chosen on the kit images: propose two enlargements (r1c1, r2c2) of S-3 and count FB and HDR labels there on a marked-up copy. Until the marked-up copy exists every count is disputed. The app's v3 counts (FB1 8, FB2 7, FB3 7, HDR1 7 …) are NOT ground truth.
The number of R.R.1 callouts is a number of zones, never rafters.
Plan callouts near the three small roofs read '2x RIDGE BM2'; resolve with the cited detail before treating places as assemblies or pieces. Places: disputed until marked.
Advisor sees two labelled ridge lines; that supports a preliminary count of two applied places, not a purchase count.
Advisor's visual count: HIP BM1 4, HIP BM2 6 labelled diagonals. Preliminary; to be marked one by one.
Many unnumbered RHDR labels; a header table/rule is printed on the sheet. An RHDR label resolves through that table, not to RHDR1 (4x8) by default.
Sizes as the app's v3 read them; re-check against the kit. Placement counts: disputed until marked.
